scope: Prior-art application with written derivation and independent review; not a new prime-distribution theorem, prime-order family construction, or achieved asymptotic relation-solving speedup.
statement: Applying Chang Corollary11 to moduli2^(k+2) supplies chosen fields and full Dickson fibres of sizeTheta(p^beta) for every fixed0<beta<5/12 on an eligible supplied odd-order curve. This removes the earlier general-Linnik-only parameter restriction while leaving the sublinear query, rank, source construction and complete solver obligations open.
